purpose: Teach: 迷宮/生業/生身/ディテール/恐怖症/遺書/言い渡し/私事

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、未解決事件の迷宮入りの社会的影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the social impact of unsolved crimes in the public consciousness.
lines.style: Even, observant tone. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Steady eye contact. Pauses slightly before the topic to let him process what's being said.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸を生業とする職人の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the working lives of traditional craftspeople.
lines.style: Quiet, measured. A slight catch before answering, like he's checking himself. Not defensive—just careful. Breath sits steady underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生身の人間を被写体とする報道倫理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on journalistic ethics when real people become the subject of reporting.
lines.style: Knowing, slightly concerned undertone. Slower pace than before. The question carries weight—she's checking in on something that matters. Warm but serious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、歴史画のディテール描写の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the detailed rendering of figures in historical paintings.
lines.style: Smaller voice this time. A beat of hesitation, like he knows she sees through him. Not evasive—just protecting something. Trails off slightly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会不安と恐怖症の関係性の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the relationship between social anxiety and phobic responses.
lines.style: Slower still. The tone drops into something closer to recognition. Not accusatory—understanding. Like she's reading between the lines and wants him to know it's okay.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の遺書の文学的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the literary study of farewell letters written in wartime.
lines.style: Almost a whisper. Breath catches slightly. Eyes down or away. The words come carefully, like a confession. Vulnerability in the silence after.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、判決の言い渡しの法社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the legal sociology of how verdicts are handed down.
lines.style: Voice softens further. No accusation whatsoever—only compassion and patience. Allows silence. She's not asking him to explain anymore.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、研究者の私事と公務の境界を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the boundary between a researcher's private life and public responsibilities.
lines.style: Voice very quiet now. Slight tremor of relief underneath—like admitting something he's been holding. Breath shallow. Eyes might meet hers briefly, searching for acceptance.
